verdict.rationale: The evidence only mentions in passing that Datadog has its own "Bits AI agents" (named in the Agent Console docs) and offers natural-language querying of infrastructure and telemetry. That suggests a built-in AI assistant exists, but nothing documents what tasks a user can delegate to it or how. Missing for 10: first-party docs describing the Bits AI assistant and its delegable tasks, examples of task delegation or autonomous actions in the product, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
